name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding & Implementation | Requirements to Go-Live, Data Imports & Integrations, Adoption | SaaS
summary: Implementation and onboarding specialist with 15+ years in SaaS, owning customers from requirements gathering through configuration, data import, integration, training, and post-launch adoption. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix with ~25 in flight at once, at 110% of implementation targets, and retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye. Builds sequenced implementation plans, protects scope, escalates risk early, and turns recurring issues into repeatable onboarding frameworks. Hands-on with Salesforce, HubSpot, REST APIs, webhooks, and data feeds, and uses AI daily for troubleshooting while validating every step before it reaches a customer.

experience.title: Client Onboarding & Implementation (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for new technology stacks, gathering requirements in discovery, translating them into technical configurations, and providing hands-on training.
Set up and run data feeds and imports into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, validating every import by re-checking results before go-live.
Build integrations with REST APIs, inbound and outbound webhooks, and OAuth and API-key credentials in Zapier, Make, and n8n, debugging failures from the JSON payload.
Use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) to speed troubleshooting and documentation, validating every generated step before applying it to a client system.
Write proposals and statements of work that define scope, and document every interaction, timeline, and deliverable in Notion and the CRM.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments for multi-stakeholder accounts, holding delivery quality consistent and resolving client feedback promptly.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a high-volume partner network, guiding customers through complex technical setup and configuration.
Built scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering, sharing structured, high-priority customer feedback that informed the roadmap.
Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners across health, home services, and retail, retaining all but one (~94% retention).

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors, managing workflows and tasks in ClickUp and Monday.com.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, managing ~25 concurrent onboardings at peak, at 110% of implementation targets.
Led onboarding and launch operations as team lead and primary contact, delivering launches on time and accelerating time-to-value.
Defined the CRM fields required for onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 specialists, running weekly training and workshops when rolling out new processes.

bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans ranking which systems to change and in what order, handing them to the implementation team to execute.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations alongside implementation teams, troubleshooting setup issues and escalating risk to leadership early.
Ran workshops for client teams showing how each part of the platform would fit their workflow.
